clue.text: Scare king during crusade

indicators.note: the king's letter happens during, so sits within, the crusade word

parts.note: a crusade is a campaign or fight
R is the abbreviation for king (Latin rex)

explanation.surface: A monarch gets a shock while away on a holy war.
explanation.definitionFit: A scare and a sudden shock of fear are synonyms, both nouns.

clue.text: Fish from lake caught by father

indicators.note: the lake letter is held inside the father word

parts.note: a founder is the father of an enterprise

explanation.surface: A fish from a lake is caught by Dad.
explanation.walkthrough: 'father' is the founder of something, not a parent.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a flatfish, an example of a fish.

clue.text: Awkward writer turned up in it

indicators.note: in places the turned word inside it
in a down clue turned up means the writer word reads bottom to top, backwards

parts.note: a pen is a writing tool

explanation.surface: A clumsy writer appears in a piece.
explanation.definitionFit: Clumsy and lacking skill, a synonym for awkward.

clue.text: Important person in recently taken photograph

parts.note: a hot item is newly stolen or fresh
a shot is a photograph

explanation.surface: A VIP appears in a fresh snapshot.
explanation.definitionFit: A hotshot is a successful, self-important person, a colloquial synonym.

clue.text: Just right for salesman retiring

parts.note: being for something is being pro it

indicators.note: retiring means going back, so the salesman word is read backwards

parts.note: a rep is a sales representative

explanation.surface: Someone approves of a salesman stepping down, calling it just right.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Just right' reads as one phrase but 'right' could tempt as R; the whole phrase is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: Something fitting or correct is described as appropriate in this sense, a synonym.

clue.text: I'm great playing Scott Joplin music

indicators.note: playing means the letters of I'm great are performed in a new order

explanation.surface: A boast: I'm great at playing Joplin.
explanation.definitionFit: Scott Joplin was the leading composer of this syncopated piano style, so it is an example.

clue.text: One buying almost flawless jumper

indicators.note: almost means the flawless word loses its final letter

parts.note: pure means flawless
a chaser is a horse that runs steeplechases over jumps

explanation.surface: A shopper picks up a nearly perfect sweater.
explanation.walkthrough: 'jumper' suggests a sweater; it is a steeplechase horse.
explanation.definitionFit: A buyer is someone who makes a purchase, a synonym.

clue.text: Feel bitter about gift head disposed of

indicators.note: the first letter of the gift word is removed

parts.note: a present is a gift

explanation.surface: Someone resents a gift that was thrown away.
explanation.definitionFit: To begrudge or feel aggrieved about something is a synonym phrase.

clue.text: Household servant having row in private

definitions.meaning: a maid or cook employed in a home is called by this word
a quarrel between partners at home, in police slang

explanation.surface: A maid quarrels behind closed doors.
explanation.definitionFit: The word names both a home-employed servant and, colloquially, a family quarrel at home.

clue.text: Chapter on model may make one think

parts.note: a template is a model or pattern

explanation.surface: A chapter about a model could prompt reflection.
explanation.definitionFit: To ponder or reflect is a synonym for thinking deeply.

clue.text: Gaudy trim, not new

indicators.note: not says the new letter is to be left out of the trim word

parts.note: to garnish is to trim or decorate

explanation.surface: A decoration that is flashy but not fresh.
explanation.definitionFit: Gaudy and garish are synonyms for showy, tastelessly bright.

clue.text: Couple, almost an item

indicators.note: almost means the couple word loses its final letter

parts.note: to couple is to join or unite

explanation.surface: A couple who are nearly 'an item' in gossip terms.
explanation.walkthrough: 'an item' looks like part of the romantic surface with 'Couple', but it is the definition.
explanation.definitionFit: A single thing or component is one element of a whole, a synonym for item.

clue.text: Together, also being dealt with by hospital

parts.note: and means also
a matter being dealt with is in hand

explanation.surface: Something is handled jointly, with a hospital involved too.
explanation.definitionFit: Going hand in hand is an idiom for being together or closely linked.

clue.text: Strangely, three sevens divided by 50 could be just the same

indicators.note: the shuffled letters are split apart by the numeral placed among them
strangely means the letters of three sevens are put in an odd new order

parts.note: L is the Roman numeral for fifty

explanation.surface: Arithmetic oddity: three sevens divided by fifty somehow gives the same result.
explanation.definitionFit: Both phrases mean 'even so' or 'however', an adverbial synonym.

clue.text: A delight, the old being entertained by editor quick to notice things

indicators.note: the inner parts are hosted inside the editor abbreviation

parts.note: glee is delight
ye is an archaic spelling of the

explanation.surface: An observant editor takes pleasure in old-fashioned English.
explanation.definitionFit: Sharp-sighted like a bird of prey, so observant: an idiom.

clue.text: Scantiness may suggest strip, say, in resort

indicators.note: re-sorted letters: the words strip and say are put in a new order

explanation.surface: Skimpy clothing, like a strip at a seaside resort.
explanation.walkthrough: 'resort' suggests a holiday town, but 'in resort' means sorted again, rearranging STRIP SAY.
explanation.definitionFit: Being thinly scattered or meagre is a synonym for scantiness.

clue.text: Form of psychiatric treatment one can't receive?

definitions.text: Form of psychiatric treatment one can't receive?

parts.words: Form of psychiatric treatment one can't receive?
parts.note: the treatment is given to several patients at once, so a lone individual cannot have it

explanation.surface: A puzzled question about a therapy closed to a single patient.
explanation.definitionFit: This kind of therapy is held with several patients together, so 'one' alone cannot get it.

clue.text: Watch old boy start a game of tennis?

parts.note: OB is the abbreviation for old boy, a former pupil
each point in tennis starts with a serve

explanation.surface: An old boy watching a tennis match open.
explanation.definitionFit: To watch and to look on attentively are synonyms.

clue.text: They may be caught at sea and obtained on wharf

definitions.text: They may be caught at sea
definitions.note: plural 'they' for a fish name whose plural is unchanged

parts.note: had means got or obtained
a dock is a wharf

explanation.surface: Fish landed at sea then unloaded on the quay.
explanation.definitionFit: This is a sea fish commonly caught by trawlers, an example.

clue.text: Student, one wearing short dress for a prank

indicators.note: the student and one are dressed in, so go inside, the shortened dress
short means the dress word loses its last letter

parts.note: a frock is a dress
L is a learner driver, a student
I is the Roman numeral for one

explanation.surface: A student puts on a mini dress as a joke.
explanation.definitionFit: A playful escapade or caper is a synonym for a prank.

clue.text: Common vegetables area produces

definitions.note: here a noun: a piece of public grassland

parts.note: greens are leafy vegetables
a ward is an area of a town or city

explanation.surface: An everyday district grows vegetables.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Common' looks like an adjective but is the noun for a village green.
explanation.definitionFit: A stretch of grassy turf, such as a village common, is a synonym.

clue.text: Jack, perhaps taken from vehicle by daughter

parts.note: a car is a vehicle

explanation.surface: Someone called Jack is fetched from a car by his daughter.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Jack' looks like a man's name; it is the playing card, signalled by 'perhaps'.
explanation.definitionFit: A jack is one example of a playing card, hence 'perhaps'.

clue.text: Innocent, the Parisian in jail

indicators.note: the French article is put inside the jail word

parts.note: the can is slang for jail
le is French for the

explanation.surface: A Parisian locked up despite being innocent.
explanation.definitionFit: Being free of guilt, with a clean record, is a synonym for innocent.

clue.text: Power: film actor

parts.note: a film is a thin coating or layer

explanation.surface: A list of credits: Tyrone Power, film actor.
explanation.walkthrough: 'film' looks like cinema but is a thin coating.
explanation.definitionFit: A performer on stage is a synonym for actor.

clue.text: Difficult to understand, man behind English boozer

indicators.note: behind places the man's name after the other parts

parts.note: a sot is a habitual drunkard
Eric is a man's name

explanation.surface: A man trailing an English drunk is hard to follow.
explanation.walkthrough: 'boozer' suggests a pub but is a drinker here.
explanation.definitionFit: Esoteric knowledge is obscure and understood by few, a synonym.

clue.text: Caddie initially glued broken club

indicators.note: initially means just the first letter of the caddie word is taken
broken says the letters of glued are rearranged

explanation.surface: A golf caddie first tries to glue a broken golf club.
explanation.walkthrough: 'club' looks like a golf club but is a cosh; 'broken' rearranges GLUED to UDGEL.
explanation.definitionFit: A short heavy stick used as a weapon is a kind of club.

clue.text: Lean film, name unknown

parts.note: a skin is a thin film on a surface
Y is an algebraic unknown

explanation.surface: A thin film from an anonymous director.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Lean' looks like a verb or the director David Lean; it is the adjective.
explanation.definitionFit: Lean and very thin are synonyms describing a slim body.
